nodes.title: My agent can't see the browser: it can't read the console, network tab or live DOM
nodes.feature_idea: Hand the captured console + network to the agent on the clipboard or in the ZIP

nodes.title: Copy-pasting logs and cURL into the agent by hand is slow, lossy and leaks tokens
nodes.feature_idea: One-click 'Copy for coding agent' (prompt + trimmed report) to the clipboard

nodes.title: People want to hand a captured bug straight to an agent, usually over MCP
nodes.feature_idea: Local one-command agent hand-off for the captured report (no MCP server)

nodes.title: A claimed fix needs visual proof: agents open PRs from an issue but nobody can see the bug is gone
nodes.feature_idea: Attach labelled before/after screenshots + an acceptance-evidence block to the issue

nodes.title: Fear of leaking secrets: screenshots, network bodies, URLs and local MCP servers
nodes.feature_idea: Auto-redact tokens/cards/URL params before the report leaves the browser

nodes.title: AI PR review has no eyes: a code diff cannot show the UI the change produces
nodes.feature_idea: Include labelled before/after screenshots + annotations next to the diff for PR review

nodes.title: Terminal agents still can't take a pasted screenshot: images in issues are unusable
nodes.feature_idea: Emit an image manifest (paths + captions) so text-only agents can read report screenshots

nodes.title: An agent cannot watch a screen recording: users need frames and a text timeline
nodes.feature_idea: Extract N key frames + a timestamped timeline from the recording into report.md

nodes.title: An agent can't reproduce the bug: missing steps, state, auth and data
nodes.feature_idea: Emit an ordered 'repro steps + required state' block for the agent

nodes.title: Triage and duplicates: reports are either too thin or far too long
nodes.feature_idea: Structured, concise issue-quality template with a right-length control

nodes.title: Environment and flaky bugs: the agent's environment does not match the reporter's
nodes.feature_idea: Add full environment context (browser/OS/viewport/extensions) — mostly covered by #29

nodes.title: Cost and context: dumping a whole capture into the prompt is big and expensive
nodes.feature_idea: Size the agent hand-off to a token/frame budget using the existing trim levels

nodes.title: Narration and annotation are the de-facto hand-off, but they are not machine-readable
nodes.feature_idea: Map annotations/narration into ordered agent-readable text next to the event they describe

nodes.title: Cloud bug-capture tools cost per seat and hoard your data
nodes.feature_idea: Free local capture → agent (competitive context, not a feature target)

top_pick.feature: One-click 'Copy for coding agent' (prompt + trimmed report) to the clipboard
